messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] script on page 140
parts:
Good question, actually! I think (!) this is a result of how
gregexpr's output has changed over time. Waaay back when, the only
attribute gregexpr returned was match.length so the old code worked
fine. In the meantime, gregepxr has accrued more attributes:

- match.length: this one is still there, but now also
- useBytes
- capture.start
- capture.length
- capture.names

Thus, you get more attributes back and sapply coerces this into a
matrix. Hence the error message. You can use either of these two
instead:

stops<-starts+unlist(sapply(matches, attributes)[1,])-1
stops<-starts+unlist(sapply(matches, attr, "match.length"))-1

Cheers,
STG
